critical_code_review_comments: Garden harvest UX: pre-mature taps award 1 petal but UI shows no visual cue (only the float). Consider an aria-live or toast. Minor.
DrawingBoard.saveDrawing uses window.prompt which is OK on web but blocked in some mobile browsers. Functional now, but consider an in-app modal long term.
BouquetBuilder localStorage capped at 12 items (slice(0,12)) — silent truncation; should toast 'shelf full' when limit hit.
OpenWhen modal close button is inside a scrollable container; on very small screens with long text, user must scroll to find it. Consider sticky close.
FlowerGarden uses window.confirm in reset() — same caveat as prompt above.
seed_data_creation: Test bouquet 'TEST_Bouquet_A' (1 sunflower + 1 rose, lavender wrap) saved to localStorage hitu_bouquets_v1. One TestDoodle drawing saved to hitu_drawings_v1. Garden state at hitu_garden_v2 (1 harvested plot, 28 petals).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 requested features (Bouquet Builder, Flower Garden, Doodle Board, Open When) verified end-to-end on 414x896 viewport. Garden is reached via hub-tile-games → games-room-garden (NOT a direct hub tile). To enter the app, click the main START button on intro before hub-tile-* tiles are visible.
rca of the issue: No bugs to root-cause; all flows behave per spec.
